messages:
claire: Heads up — noticed a tail-latency bump on searchwave at 5% in ap-south. Suggest we hit the traffic brake and triage before widening.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout initiated: searchwave v1.9.0 -> 5% ap-south at 2999991109. Health: degraded, errors 0.4% (expected 0.05%), p99 +210ms.

devon: Agree with brake. Can someone post the quick graf snapshot?

claire: https://monitoring.redwood/internal/d/searchwave-canary — p95 230ms, p99 610ms, errors concentrated on tokenizer-cache miss on nodegroup b.

alix: If it's cache miss on nodegroup b, pinning ap-south to v1.8.7 is low-risk. That keeps release notes intact and gives infra breathing room.

infra-tom: Pin command I can run: ```redwood routing set --svc searchwave --region ap-south --target v1.8.7 --reason "percent brake due to p99 spike"```

claire: I approve. Also want a brief rollback threshold: sustained errors >1.0% for 5m OR p99 > 900ms for 10m -> escalate full rollback.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Routing override request #ROUTE-7777 created by infra-tom. Pending execution.

infra-tom: Executing override now. Will report shortly.

(25s)

infra-tom: Done. ap-south pinned to v1.8.7. Verified traffic shifted back to stable. p99 returned to baseline within 45s. :white_check_mark:

devon: Thanks. Leaving canary traffic logically at 5% but effectively drained. No percent bumps or cross-region promotion until infra confirms fix.

alix: I'll add a short note in release-notes: "v1.9.0 rollout temporarily braked in ap-south; pinned to v1.8.7 pending RCA."

claire: Assigning root-cause to infra/serving on the ticket. We'll reopen thread if rollback becomes necessary.
